title: Full-Stack Developer (Node.js / NestJS, Angular)
description:
We are looking for a Mid-level Full-Stack Developer (3+ years of experience) to work on a modern web project using an up-to-date technology stack.


🧩 Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain the backend using NestJS (Node.js)
  • Work with MySQL databases via TypeORM
  • Develop the frontend using Angular 21
  • Integrate third-party services and APIs
  • Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code
  • Participate in code reviews and team-based development

  • Work with Git (version control)


    🛠 Requirements:

  • 3+ years of commercial experience in Full-Stack development
  • Strong knowledge of TypeScript
  • Experience with NestJS / Node.js
  • Experience with TypeORM
  • Hands-on experience with MySQL
  • Experience developing with Angular (version 21 or a close equivalent)

  • Confident use of Git

     

    ⭐ Nice to have:

  • Experience working with the OpenAI API
  • Experience using Docker
  • Writing and maintaining automated tests with Playwright


🎯 We offer:

  • Work on an interesting and technology-driven project
  • A friendly team and comfortable communication
  • Fully remote work format
  • Competitive salary (depending on experience)
